Mina: available Tue Apr 5 at 9:30am PT for a short pre-demo call (20 mins) and then the demo slot after that. Dev: I can block Wed Apr 6 1:00–2:00pm PT as an alternative if procurement prefers mid-week.

If security prefers a sandboxed walkthrough we can switch to a dedicated infra session afterwards; otherwise we’ll keep it in the main call and share architecture diagrams.

Quick ask: if you confirm the 9:30am Tue slot I’ll have Marissa send the updated calendar invite and include a short mutual action plan in the event description so procurement and legal have the next steps (PO, SOC2 evidence, SSO integration timeline).
